title: node-pptx-templater — High-Performance OpenXML PowerPoint Template Engine
tagline: Populate and generate PowerPoint templates dynamically in Node.js and serverless runtimes without Microsoft Office dependencies.
description: Production-ready, pure JavaScript PowerPoint (PPTX) OpenXML template engine for Node.js, Express, Fastify, AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers, and Vercel Edge. Dynamically replace text, update native charts with Excel Dual-Sync, format tables with multi-slide pagination, manage shapes and media, and merge slides with zero Office dependencies.
author: node-pptx-templater contributors

step.name: Install node-pptx-templater
step.text: Install the package using npm: npm install node-pptx-templater

step.name: Load PowerPoint Template
step.text: Load an existing .pptx file, remote URL, or binary Buffer using PPTXTemplater.load().

step.name: Perform Templating & Mutations
step.text: Select slides, replace text tags, format tables with automatic pagination, update charts, or inject hyperlinks.

step.name: Export Generated Presentation
step.text: Export cleanly to file (saveToFile), stream (toStream), Buffer (toBuffer), Express res (toExpress), or Fastify reply (toFastify).
